attributes.name: promo tile fill
attributes.definition: What fills the background of promotional tiles: photography or flat colour, and whether a scrim is applied.

values.definition: Solid colour fields, no photos, with a darkening gradient overlay behind text.
Solid colour fields without photos or overlay.

attributes.name: tile grid spacing
attributes.definition: Whether adjacent tiles or cards are separated by gutters or sit flush edge to edge.

values.definition: Tiles touch with no gutters or margins.
Visible gaps and margins between tiles or cards.
Flush in some sections (e.g. top) and gapped in others (e.g. later grids).
